messages:
Lena: FYI moving the roadmap deep-dive to 11:10 PT (pushed by 10m) because finance needs a quick billing update in the first half. Apologies for the shuffle.
Ravi: Noted. Can we still keep Q&A at the end? A few customers sent questions we should surface.
Lena: Yes Q&A remains at 11:50, we'll shorten the product demos by 5m.
Marcos: Quick ops shout: last all-hands the recording lost captions after a ~7m gap. Is anybody changing encoder settings?
Olivia: I swapped in a new RTMP bridge last week. It had a different caption passthrough setting. I reverted but want to run one more pre-check.
stream-bot: Streaming infra (eu-west-1) status: OK. Current RTMP bridges: 3 active, 0 degraded. Caption service: available=true, latency=95ms.
Ravi: Can we also enable dual-recording? Local OBS + cloud S3 fallback just in case. That saved us on the last town hall.
Marcos: Good call. Olivia: do you have the OBS scene saved for presenters? If not I can push the config: 
```
obs-cli scenes export --scene "AllHands_Presenter" --file /tmp/ah-scene.json
```
Olivia: I have it. I'll start a dry-run at 10:52 PT (8 min before start). Everyone presenting: test your camera and mic on Zoom beforehand.
Lena: Also reminder: do not show any unreleased roadmap slides; mark them as "internal only" in the deck. We'll keep any embargoed screenshots blacked out.
Ravi: On retention: recordings default to 90d. For confidential slides we can mark the file with restricted ACL and manual purge after 7d. Ping security if you need an exception.
Marcos: If audio drops we'll switch to audio-only livestream and post a note to the internal feed + add a pinned comment with the recording link.
stream-bot: Backup recording (local OBS) detected on host "olivia-mbp". Upload queued: 0/1.
Olivia: Starting upload now. ETA ~2m.
Lena: Thanks all — I'll post the updated agenda and the meeting notes channel after the meeting. Please keep questions short in chat so Mike can triage.
Ravi: I'll compile top 3 roadmap questions during the live Q&A for leadership to answer and open follow-up threads for the rest. :thumbsup:
